spans.s: व्य्—ओ᳙कस् mfn. dwelling apart, Br.
व्य्—ओ᳙दन (ए, ind., accord. to Sāy. = विविधे ऽन्ने लब्धे सति), RV. viii, 63, 9.
1. व्य्—ओमन् mfn. (for 2. see s.v.) one who cannot be saved (?), Kāṭh.

2. व्यो᳙मन् n. (for 1. see p. 1029, col. 1; accord. to Uṇ. iv, 150 fr. √ व्ये accord. to others fr. वि-√ अव् or √ वे) heaven, sky, atmosphere, air (व्योम्ना, व्योम-मार्गेण or -वर्त्मना, ‘through the air’), RV. &c. &c.
space, Kap.
ether (as an element), Kāv.; Pur.; Suśr.
wind or air (of the body), BhP.
water, L.
talc, mica, L.
a temple sacred to the sun, L.
a partic. high number, L.
the 10th astrol. mansion, VarBṛS.
preservation, welfare, TS. (= रक्षण, Sch.)
व्यो᳙मन् m. a partic. Ekāha, ŚrS.
N. of Prajā-pati or the Year (personified), TS.; VS. (Mahīdh.)
of Viṣṇu, Viṣṇ.
of a son of Daśārha, Hariv.; Pur. (v.l. व्योम).
See s.v.
व्य्-ओ᳙ष mf(आ)n. (fr. वि + √ उष्; cf. √ व्युष्) burning, scorching, AV.
व्य्-ओ᳙ष m. a species of elephant, L.
व्य्-ओ᳙ष n. the three hot substances (viz. dry ginger, long pepper, and black pepper), Suśr.
‘making the sound व्यो’, a blacksmith, Hcar.
1. व्योम (for 2. See col. 3), in comp. for 2. व्योमन्.
2. व्योम m. (for 1. See col. 2) N. of a son of Daśārha, Pur. (v.l. for व्योमन्).
व्योम—केश (ŚatarUp.; MBh.) or व्योम—केशिन् (L.), m. ‘sky-haired’, N. of Śiva.
व्योम—केश (ŚatarUp.; MBh.) or व्योम—केशिन् (L.), m. ‘sky-haired’, N. of Śiva.
व्योम—ग mfn. moving through the air, flying, Kathās.
व्योम—ग m. a being that moves in the air, a divine being, Śiś.
व्योम—गङ्गा f. the heavenly Ganges, MBh.; Kāv.
व्योम—गमनी f. (with विद्या) the magic art of flying, Kathās.
व्योम—गामिन् mfn. = -ग, ib.
व्योम—गुण m. ‘quality of the air’, sound, L.
व्योम—चर mfn. id., Kāv.
व्योम—चर m. a planet, Gol.
व्योम—चारिन् mfn. = -ग, VarBṛS.; Kathās.
a bird, L.
a divine being, god, Rājat.
= चिर-जीविन् and द्वि-जात (prob. ‘a bird’), L.
a saint, W.
a Brāhman, W.
a heavenly body, A.
व्योम—चा˚रि-पुर n. ‘sky-floating city’, the city of Hari-ścandra (supposed to be suspended between heaven and earth), L.
व्योम—देव m. N. of Śiva, MW.
व्योम—धारण m. mercury, L.
व्योम—धूम m. ‘sky smoke’, smoke or a cloud, L.
व्योम—ध्वनि m. a sound coming from the sky (˚नि-पति), Hcat. (cf. -शब्द)
व्योम—नासिका f. a quail, L.
a sort of quail, W.
व्योम—पञ्चक n. (prob.) the five apertures in the body, Cat.
व्योम—पाद mfn. one whose foot stands in the air (Viṣṇu), Pañcar.
व्योम—पुष्प n. a flower in the air (i.e. any impossibility or absurdity), HPariś. (cf. ख-प्˚).
व्योम—मञ्जर, n. (‘sky-cluster’) or व्योम—मण्डल, n. (‘sky-circle’) a flag, banner, L.
व्योम—मञ्जर, n. (‘sky-cluster’) or व्योम—मण्डल, n. (‘sky-circle’) a flag, banner, L.
व्योम—मध्ये ind. in the middle of the sky, in mid-air, Vikr.
व्योम—माय mf(आ)n. ‘sky-measuring’, reaching to the sky, high as the heaven, W.
व्योम—मुद्गर m. ‘sky-hammer’, a gust of wind, L.
व्योम—मृग (prob.) m. N. of one of the Moon's ten horses, L. (cf. व्योमिन्).
व्योम—यान n. ‘sky-vehicle’, a celestial car, chariot of the gods, Cat.
व्योम—रत्न n. ‘sky-jewel’, the sun, L.
व्योम—वती f. N. of a Comm.
व्योम—वर्त्मन् n. the path of the sky (˚मना through the air or sky), Kathās.
व्योम—वल्लिका f. Cassyta Filiformis, L.
व्योम—विस्तृत n. the expanse of heaven, the sky firmament, W.
व्योम—व्यापिन् mfn. filling the sky, Śiś.
व्योम—शब्द m. = -ध्वनि, Hcat.
व्योम—शिवाचार्य m. N. of an author, Cat.
व्योम—स॑द् mfn. dwelling in the sky, RV.; VS.
व्योम—स॑द् m. a deity, W.
a Gandharva, MW.
a spirit, W.
व्योम—सम्भवा f. a spotted cow, L.
व्योम—सरित् f. = -गङ्गा, Kathās.
व्योम—स्थ mfn. being on or in the sky, Śiś.
व्योम—स्थली f. ‘ground of the sky’, the earth (?), L.
व्योम—स्पृश् mfn. sky-touching, reaching to the sky, Śiś.
talc, mica, L.
original germ (= मूल-कारण), L.
‘lord of the heaven’, N. of Śiva, Hcat.
1000 billions, JaimUp.
‘heaven-like’, a Buddha, L.
N. of a being reckoned among the Viśve Devāḥ, MBh.
moving exclusively in the air (as a bird), Pañcat. ii, 21 (v.l.)
‘sky-water’, rain-water, L.
(gender doubtful) a kind of ornament, Buddh.
N. of one of the Moon's ten horses, VP. (cf. व्योम-मृग).
